test_checkpoint_resume_initial_program: test that the openevolve controller adds the initial program to the database on a fresh start
test_duplicate_content_prevention: test that programs with identical content are not added to the database multiple times
test_checkpoint_resume_skips_initial_pro: test that the initial program is not re-added when resuming from a saved checkpoint
test_non_empty_database_at_iteration_zer: test that the initial program is skipped when the database already contains programs at iteration zero
test_multiple_run_calls_no_pollution: test that calling run multiple times does not duplicate programs or re-evaluate the initial program
